brief_text: Use gravity 9.81 m/s2, contact friction 0.72, restitution 0.04, hinge damping 0.04 N m s/rad, and slide damping 0.20 N s/m; start every body from rest. Balls are 0.10 m diameter and 0.20 kg, dominoes are 0.08 by 0.04 by 0.24 m and 0.25 kg, carts are 0.22 by 0.18 by 0.10 m and 0.50 kg, blocks are 0.12 m cubes and 0.35 kg, ramps are 1.00 m long and 0.30 m wide at 20 degrees, and horizontal rings have 0.16 m clear diameter. Ball1 starts 0.30 m above ring1 and drops vertically through it. Ball1 falls another 0.25 m and touches the left end of lever1, a 0.60 by 0.10 by 0.04 m, 0.50 kg center-hinged lever. Lever1 rotates clockwise through 45 degrees to its lower stop, and its rising right end knocks cart1 along a horizontal slide. Cart1 slides 0.42 m and touches domino1.

usage.text:
No. Ball1 drops through ring1, strikes lever1, and comes to rest by about 1.41 s. The lever strikes cart1 and reaches its 45° stop, but rebounds and settles at 38.3°. Cart1 then hits the domino platform at about 1.23 s, stopping roughly 4 cm short of domino1; the domino is never touched.

The correction moves the platform out of the striker’s path. It also gives the lever a slightly top-heavy mass distribution—without changing its dimensions, mass, or central hinge—so gravity holds it against the lower stop after the strike. This revised file has not been rerun here.
